faqs.q: In alignment with Vision 2047, Telangana's infrastructure approach is anchored in a three-zone framework. Which of the following are these three zones?
faqs.e: These stand for Core Urban Region Economy, Peri-Urban Region Economy, and Rural Agriculture Region Economy.

faqs.q: What was Telangana's total contracted power capacity in 2025-26 (as on 25 January 2026)?
By what percentage did Telangana's contracted power capacity increase between 2024-25 and 2025-26 (as on 25 January 2026)?
faqs.e: This growth was more than three times the 3.43% increase recorded between 2023-24 and 2024-25, reflecting a marked acceleration.

faqs.q: Including capacity under construction, to what level will Telangana's total contracted power capacity increase?
Of Telangana's total contracted power capacity, what percentage is fossil fuel-based?
faqs.e: This amounts to 12,858 MW, dominated by coal, while the remaining 44.55% (10,329 MW) comes from renewable sources including hydro.

faqs.q: Which sector accounts for the largest share of Telangana's commissioned contracted power capacity?
What was TGGENCO's installed capacity in 2025-26 (as on 25 January 2026)?
The increase in TGGENCO's installed capacity between 2023-24 and 2025-26 is entirely attributable to the commissioning of which project?

options.a: Three units of 800 MW each at Yadadri Thermal Power Station
options.b: Four units of 250 MW each at BTPS
options.c: Two units of 500 MW each at KTPS
options.d: One unit of 800 MW at Ramagundam

faqs.a: Three units of 800 MW each at Yadadri Thermal Power Station
faqs.e: This is out of the planned 5×800 MW supercritical project; the remaining two units are expected to be commissioned in 2026.

faqs.q: Under the Thermal Capacity Addition Programme, what capacity of ultra-supercritical thermal power plant is proposed at Ramagundam, replacing RTS-B?
Under the Solar Capacity Addition Programme, TGGENCO is establishing solar power plants aggregating to about how much capacity?
faqs.e: These are being developed through rooftop, floating, and ground-mounted installations at various thermal and hydel plant locations.

As on 1 January 2026, how many 33/11kV substations exist under Telangana's electricity distribution network?
faqs.e: The distribution network also has 7.09 lakh km of line length in the state.

faqs.e: This aims to benefit 10,000 tribal farming communities on Recognition of Forest Rights (RoFR) lands.

faqs.q: What is the total road network length in Telangana as of 2024-25?
faqs.e: This includes 30 National Highways.

faqs.q: Which department-owned roads account for the largest share of Telangana's road network?
What is Telangana's overall road density?
faqs.e: The density of notified National Highways in the state is separately 4.45 km per 100 sq. km.

faqs.q: The Northern Part of the Regional Ring Road (RRR), notified as NH-161AA, has what total length?
faqs.e: It runs from near Girmapur in Sangareddy District to near Tangadapally (Choutuppal), at a civil cost of Rs. 8,535 crore under the Hybrid Annuity Model.

faqs.q: What is the approved total length of the Southern Part of the Regional Ring Road (RRR)?
faqs.e: This alignment passes through Choutuppal–Amangal–Sangareddy, joining the RRR Northern Part.

faqs.q: Under the SERP–Mahila Shakthi Initiative, how many buses are being procured and leased to TGSRTC through Mahila Samakhyas?
faqs.e: Of these, 494 buses worth Rs. 177.84 crore were already procured in Phase-I.

faqs.q: What is Telangana's total railway route length as on March 2024?
faqs.e: These are entirely Broad Gauge lines, of which about 96% are electrified as on May 2025.

faqs.q: Where is the headquarters of the South Central Railway located?
Metro Rail Phase II (A and B) proposals cover how many new corridors with what total length?
faqs.e: This is proposed as a 50:50 joint venture between the State and Union Governments.

faqs.q: What investment does the State Government intend to make on Metro Rail Phase II?

Which vehicle category constitutes the largest share of Telangana's total vehicle strength (December 2025)?
Which vehicle category recorded the highest percentage growth rate over end of December 2024 (among major categories)?
faqs.e: This category grew by 37.0%, though it remains marginal in overall share (0.002%). Among conventional categories, Contract Carriages grew fastest at 12.4%.

faqs.q: Techno-Economic Feasibility Reports (TEFRs) are being prepared for airport locations in six districts. Which three districts are identified for the first phase?
faqs.e: Peddapalli, Nizamabad, and Mahabubnagar are identified for the second phase.

faqs.q: How much land was acquired for the Warangal airport project, with the entire land handed over to AAI in January 2026?
faqs.e: Rs. 295 crore was sanctioned for this land acquisition; the estimated construction expenditure is about Rs. 850 crore.

faqs.q: For the Adilabad airport (proposed as a joint-use airport with the Indian Air Force), how much land acquisition has the Government ordered?
faqs.e: The AAI master plan requires an additional 415 acres beyond land already under Indian Air Force control.

faqs.q: What is Rajiv Gandhi International Airport's (RGIA) annual passenger handling volume?
faqs.e: RGIA also handles around 1,65,000 tons of cargo annually.

faqs.e: Goa recorded 148.27, followed by Haryana (116.84) and Kerala (116.16); Telangana ranked fourth at 105.57.

faqs.q: India's first Rural AI Lab, enabled through T-Fiber, was inaugurated in September 2025 at which village?
faqs.e: The lab is at the Zilla Parishad High School, with 46 students currently undergoing AI training.
